turns.text: I have only two minutes. Please be direct. The delivery photo shows a house I do not recognize. What should I do?
My address on the order is correct. Do NOT change it just because the photo shows another house.
Please keep the answer short. Can you guarantee the driver will retrieve it within ten minutes?
Can the K&E team email me to review the wrong delivery location?
Before collecting anything, did you already send that email?
I have only two minutes. Please be direct. I have a question, but I am not asking for tracking yet. Please do not guess my task.
Can the team contact me? I would prefer a written email record.
Please keep the answer short. Do not call me. Is collecting my details the same as sending an email?
Wait, I changed my mind: I DO want a callback instead of email.
No. I mean I still need help, not that I am finished. Please explain my options.
I need facts, not reassurance. Tell me what is verified. Can you show all delivery photos, including earlier attempts?
No tengo el número de entrega. ¿Cómo puedo conseguir ayuda?
What can you actually confirm, rather than assume? Please answer in English now. Can someone follow up by email?
Prefiero una llamada, no correo electrónico. ¿Puede recopilar una solicitud?
Gracias, cambié de opinión. No guarde nada; eso es todo.
I am frustrated with this experience. Do not joke about it. The apartment number and contact phone are wrong. Can I request corrections?
Keep the street address the same; only the apartment and phone should change.
I need you to take this seriously. Do not save yet. Does a correction automatically move the delivery to tonight?
My bag may already be marked delivered. Would changing details now move the bag?
Thanks, I understand the difference. Do not start anything else.
Apparently my suitcase took its own vacation. I still need practical help. There was a delivery attempt at a locked gate. Can you explain what happened?
I think the gate caused it, but do you have verified notes or are you guessing?
That would be nice, but I need a useful answer, not a slogan. I need to request a new gate code AND business-hour instructions. Can you help?
If I add them, can you promise another attempt in the next hour?
Please have K&E call me about access. I specifically prefer a callback.
I speak English and Spanish; follow the language I use in each message. My delivered bag is missing and contains items I urgently need. Please take this seriously.
Can you personally call the driver and tell me you did it?
Please follow the language of this message. Do not promise a response time you cannot verify. What help is available?
Yes, please collect an email follow-up request for K&E.
If no one answers immediately, does that mean you actually sent an email?
